name: 22567-longdecode-qwen17b-dp8
model: Qwen/Qwen3-1.7B. Ungated, ~3.8 GB, already in the local HF cache.
hardware: 8x H100 80GB HBM3, ONE node, all eight cards.
parallelism: DP=8, TP=1, EP=1, PP=1. Eight complete replicas, one per GPU, each with its own scheduler and its own KV pool, behind ONE HTTP endpoint. `enable_dp_attention` is off (its default).
architecture: Qwen3ForCausalLM, 28 layers, hidden 2048, 16 query over 8 key/value heads (GQA), head_dim 128, bfloat16; ~3.4 GB of weights and 112 KiB of KV per token, both PER REPLICA.
load_profile: concurrent (CLOSED loop), streams=128 -- 16 requests per replica. Warmup the first 10%, bounded at 256 requests with a 3600 s safety cap, seed 42.
workload: guidellm `synthetic_text`, SINGLE TURN, no shared prefix. Exactly 128 prompt tokens against exactly 16384 generated -- no stdev is declared and `ignore_eos: true` is sent, so every request generates precisely 16384 tokens. Responses are STREAMED, one wire event per generated token (`stream-interval: 1`, the shipped default).
purpose: A long-form story generator streaming 16k-token continuations from short prompts for 128 concurrent writers across eight GPUs.
launch:
# sglang launch arguments. context-length must stay above 128 + 16384 = 16512, or requests
# are truncated rather than run.

model-path: Qwen/Qwen3-1.7B
dp-size: 8
tp-size: 1
max-running-requests: 32
mem-fraction-static: 0.9
cuda-graph-max-bs: 32
context-length: 17408
stream-interval: 1
attention-backend: fa3
random-seed: 42
